exposure: Congenital adrenal hyperplasia (CAH) (nonclassic [NC], simple virilizing [SV], salt wasting [SW])
cohort: The study included 72 adult women with congenital adrenal hyperplasia (34 nonclassic, 21 simple virilizing, 17 salt wasting) across tertiary reference centers.
finding: The study found prolonged latency to pregnancy and high use of fertility treatments in CAH patients, but overall pregnancy and perinatal outcomes were favorable with abortion rates not increased.
mod_finding: Primary cesarean section rates were higher than in the general population (60.9%), but a notable proportion of women with SV (23.8%) and SW (29.4%) gave birth naturally.
birth_weight: Children categorized as small for gestational age were 20.5%.
